summary: Frontend-only retest after Remote rebuild + new Atelier tab. Mobile viewport 390x844. All 5 tabs render (Télécommande / Égaliseur / Explorateur / Atelier / Bibliothèque). Remote screen: every required testID is present (32/32: power-btn, led-dimmer-btn, mute-btn, volume-down-btn, volume-up-btn, prev-btn, play-pause-btn, next-btn, source-cycle-btn, source-{opt,aux,bt,usb}-card, mode-{movie,music,voice,sport,game,night}-card, bass/midrange/treble/surround/prompt down+up-btn, usb-repeat-btn, eq-reset-btn, device-reset-btn). Pressing unbound power-btn shows app-toast '« Marche / Arrêt » non liée — associez une commande'. Mute toggles its active/danger state (verified visually — VolumeX icon + 'MUET' label appear in dial). Volume +2/+2 takes dial from 30 -> 34. Mode/source cards highlight correctly. Atelier: atelier-disconnected-card renders with the 'Découverte du protocole' header; goto-explorer-btn navigates to /explorer where ble-unavailable-card is shown — as expected, capture/builder UI is gated behind live BLE. Bibliothèque: all 32 bind-{control} rows render across all 6 groups (Alimentation & Volume, Lecture, Sources [5], Modes son [6], Réglages audio [10], Système [3 incl bind-led_dimmer / bind-eq_reset / bind-device_reset]); stats counters render; tapping bind-bass_up opens command-picker-modal. EQ regression OK (bass-down/up + treble-down/up buttons all present, presets render, sliders + save/reset visible). Explorateur regression OK (ble-unavailable-card on web, no crash). 0 console errors during the full run.

issues: Bottom tab labels 'Télécommande' and 'Bibliothèque' are visibly truncated to 'Télécomm…' and 'Bibliothè…' on a 390px-wide viewport (5 tabs, fontSize 9.5). Other 3 labels render fully. Not blocking; consider shortening labels (e.g. 'Remote' / 'Biblio') or reducing letterSpacing/horizontal padding. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:21-25

action_items: (Cosmetic) Reduce/abbreviate the longest tab titles in (tabs)/_layout.tsx or lower tabBarLabelStyle.letterSpacing/padding so 'Télécommande' and 'Bibliothèque' aren't clipped at 390px width.
critical_code_review_comments: remote.tsx (419 lines): clean composition with ControlButton/SelectCard/StepperRow/VolumeDial, every interactive element has a testID, isBound() drives the dashed-border 'unbound' visual everywhere, persisted state (volume/muted/mode/source) restored from storage on mount.
atelier.tsx correctly gates the capture + frame-builder UI behind ble.connectionState === 'connected'; web preview only ever sees atelier-disconnected-card — matches the agent-to-agent context note.
atelier.tsx useEffect on line 95 has a deliberate eslint-disable for exhaustive-deps with comment — acceptable.
controls.ts CONTROL_GROUPS lists exactly the 32 bindable slots the request enumerates (4 alim+vol, 4 lecture, 5 sources, 6 modes, 10 audio steppers, 3 système). Counts match.
All new files use StyleSheet.create, all text is wrapped in <Text>, no HTML elements, no deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch references found.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created this iteration — UI-only verification on the public preview URL.
